about: The class of every verb of the mod GateKit AI (docs/api-rules.md#fair-cheat-observation), by its path under AI. Read at start into AI.Class.

Accent.why: GK.Say.Accent's effect and GK.Focus's marker where the game would not show them, and the camera's fair focus

Ask.why: carries out an act on the client

Look.why: reads; moves the session's cursor and writes a row

Notes.Add.why: writes a file of the copy, nothing of the game

Notes.Clear.why: empties a file of the copy, nothing of the game

Session.Start.why: sets how much the agent may know; writes a file of the copy

Row.why: writes a row of the mod's family

Say.why: a line over a head (GK.Say.Line: a status of GateKit's own) and its accent

Scene.why: runs a function of a staged scene

Step.why: an act by any of three ways - fair, GateKit's scripted order, a named cheat (AI.Acts says which): the whole is held to the widest
